text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just... a little bit.
However, I am not worried.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am running together
with the time I have built up with you..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall be on my way.
So that you may welcome me back with a smile...
I will return shortly."
